title: Google Ads Cost Per Call
narration: This chart highlights key statistics related to Google Ads for local businesses. A recent study found that 68% of local searches lead to a purchase within 24 hours, demonstrating the immediate impact of targeted online advertising. Businesses with complete Google Business Profiles receive 2.5 times more calls than those with incomplete profiles.  A cost per call of $5 or less is generally considered excellent for local businesses, showcasing the potential for a strong return on investment.
